description.p: OpenHamShack QO-100 NB is a native desktop transceiver for the QO-100 amateur satellite's narrowband segment. One process owns a software-defined radio and the whole user interface: a bandscope and waterfall across the transponder, beacon and transmit frequency locking, and CW, SSB, FT8, FT4, PSK31/63/125, RTTY, FreeDV and SSTV receive modes.

It works with the ADALM-Pluto family (Pluto, Pluto+, LibreSDR, Pluto nano) for full transmit and receive, or with any SoapySDR-supported receiver for receive only. A simulated QO-100 downlink lets it run, and be explored, with no radio attached.
